title: Webster Hubbell's book on Clinton's JFK and UFO inquiries
summary: Steven Greer tells of Webster Hubbell's book on Clinton's JFK and UFO inquiries, about 1990s at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: book. Um and in it, he admits that he and the president were trying to get to the bottom of a couple things. One of them was who killed Jack Kennedy and why and what's going on with UFOs.
because her husband really tried until they crushed down Webster Hubble after asking
tellings.difference: Adds that Hubbell was 'crushed down' after asking, and does not mention the book or JFK.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Bill Clinton and Webster Hubbell trying to get to the bottom of UFOs in the 1990s.
